summary: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Priority Payment Systems, LLC, acquired all membership interests of Convenient Payments, LLC from Convenient Payments Acquisition Subsidiary, LLC. The transaction closed simultaneously on August 25, 2026. Purchase price comprised $11.5 million cash subject to adjustments, plus up to $3.5 million in earnout payments over eight fiscal quarters based on gross profit. The company guaranteed PPS's payment obligations. No board recommendation or advisors named. The acquisition expands Priority's payment services footprint. Watch for earnout achievement and integration performance.
